column1: # Fleet build — every example built with a fresh .tish/gba against the compiler of the day.
# 112 PASS / 2 FAIL, after the M5 scope fix (tishlang/tish 830d03b88) took 49 examples back.
# The 2 remaining failures are MISSING ASSETS, not code:
#   bench-room            -> an asset from the topdown RPG port  (does not exist)
#   repro-hub-cave-heap   -> a map asset from the same port      (does not exist; the .map.bin does)
# Both reference assets from the topdown RPG port (moved to its own repo) that were renamed or
# never committed; neither is a compiler
# or engine defect. Previous run of this file: 63 PASS / 51 FAIL.
# Reproduce: TISH_GBA_TARGET_DIR=<shared dir>, then per example `rm -rf .tish/gba && npm run build`.
